status: bounded source, transport and local-browser review; archive public, game release and physical-device acceptance pending
scope: Continue the existing eight procedural audio recipes while adding a bounded, rights-aware public soundtrack catalogue reader, native searchable Music Player UI, direct immutable HTTPS MP3 streaming and explicit Content ID policy preservation through the archive boundary.

changedInputs.assessment: Adds an explicit remote playlist source to the existing single transport. Exact archive namespace, SHA identity and immutable object path are revalidated before mutation. Recording mode filters remote queues on initial selection and saved-library refresh; rejected selections remain atomic and restricted active media is retired immediately.

Adds search, style and collection filters, one-click track playback and shuffle-all for the public archive. Loading is nonblocking, aborts on close/disposal, applies Recording mode to visible results and reports failure without disabling built-in, installed or uploaded music.
Adds a bounded scroll region, responsive track rows and existing-focus-token treatment for the native catalogue browser without changing gameplay geometry or input ownership.

Introduces the public catalogue trust boundary: exact schema and count checks, streamed 512 KiB decode with cancellation, direct nonredirecting credential-free fetch, the exact project archive namespace, supported public licences, pending game-admission status, SHA-named MP3 paths and explicit Content ID/Recording-mode policy fields.

focusedAutomated: 161 soundtrack catalogue, player and panel tests passed on Node 20.19.5.

Tests cover direct streaming without local blob reads, pause/resume, exit to built-in music, strict archive namespace/hash/duplicate rejection, bounded streamed catalogue cancellation, Content ID and Recording-mode enforcement on selection and saved-library refresh, atomic invalid-input refusal, search/style filters, one-click selection, shuffle-all, fetch failure and abort-on-close.

Independent RAM probes reproduced the four initial trust-boundary failures, then verified their fixes plus the two follow-on Recording-mode transition cases against the unmodified final working sources.

observed: The Music Player loaded the live public catalogue and reported 104 of 104 published recordings inside the existing dialog.
All eight collections were visible, including both requested metal-groove audition batches; search, style, collection, shuffle and refresh controls remained in the native panel.
Selecting Revenge's Waiting changed the native Now Playing row to the exact title and creator and streamed the public MP3 through the shared transport without opening a tab.
localBrowser.screenshots: Inspected through the rendered app and accessibility tree; no image is claimed as release evidence.

unchangedBindings: The eight selected audio roles retain their procedural recipe IDs and generate no new cue or music bytes. Master/effects gain authority, saved library formats, IndexedDB, rights enforcement, offline albums and user-uploaded originals are unchanged. The catalogue policy addition preserves source restrictions and grants no new permission.
excluded: No musical-fit, full-track listening, loudness, Ukrainian cultural or Content ID approval for any archive recording.
No cold-offline promise for the streaming catalogue; offline use remains owned by existing installed albums and uploads.
No physical iPhone, controller, screen-reader, every-viewport, frozen-build, public game release or human acceptance.
No admission of archive previews into trusted Automatic or built-in genre playlists.
decision: Approve this bounded functional audio-source successor only when the exact prior review, current fingerprint and this review remain byte-identical. The public archive is verified separately; merged-source qualification, immutable game release and public game playback remain separate gates.

independentReview.result: The initial review reproduced four blockers. Follow-up exact working-tree probes verified all four repairs and two transition edge cases with no remaining transport/parser blocker.
independentReview.scopeLimit: No musical, offline, physical-device, frozen-artifact or public-game approval.
